the copula approach is the best methodology in terms of goodness of fit, and that the independent component analysis is the best methodology to estimate risk of financial portfolios.

the copula approach is more flexible to capture the dependence structure than the independent component analysis, and that the Monte Carlo simulation can be used to estimate risk of financial portfolios.
